caseName: Hawaiian Airlines, Inc. v. Norris and Finazzo v. Norris
caseNameFull: Hawaiian Airlines, Inc. v. Norris; And Finazzo Et Al. v. Norris

opinions.text: Sup. Ct. Haw. Motion of Air Transport Association of America for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. The Solicitor General is invited to file a brief in this case expressing the views of the United States.
